title: Shawbrook provides £4.5m for Bath quarry site homes
summary:
Shawbrook Bank has provided a £4.5 million development finance facility to Arc X Developments for a residential scheme on a former stone quarry site in Combe Down, approximately 2.5 kilometres from Bath city centre. The 21-month facility covers both land acquisition and construction of six detached homes on the woodland site, which carries an expected gross development value of approximately £6.75 million.

title: Hampshire Trust Bank completes £22m Nottingham refinance
summary:
Hampshire Trust Bank has completed £22 million of lending across a mixed property portfolio in Nottingham, three weeks after issuing offers. The specialist bank structured two 10-year facilities to refinance existing borrowing and raise additional capital against a portfolio comprising purpose-built student accommodation, houses in multiple occupation and semi-commercial property.

summary:

title: AI property portal MyPorta claims larger inventory than Rightmove
summary:
MyPorta, an AI-powered property portal offering free agent listings, has launched claiming to host 860,242 UK properties—182,000 more than Rightmove. The platform uses automated indexing of agents' websites combined with conversational search technology.

title: Estate agency dress codes debated after Lords tie rule change
summary:
The House of Lords has voted to make ties optional, prompting debate about professional dress codes in estate agency. Many property firms continue to require formal attire, particularly suits and ties, as part of maintaining professional standards.

title: England and Wales homebuying reforms aim to cut delays
summary:
The UK Government's proposed reforms to the homebuying and selling process in England and Wales aim to reduce transaction delays and failures through upfront information provision, earlier legal commitment and increased use of digital data tools. The roadmap includes sales packs that have drawn comparisons with the suspended Home Information Packs introduced in 2007.

title: Mansfield street sees 36% of homes converted to HMOs
summary:
A residential street in Mansfield has seen 15 of its 42 properties converted to houses in multiple occupation, with landlords targeting higher rental yields. Residents have raised concerns about parking congestion and infrastructure capacity as conversions continue.

title: AI-generated complaints adding delays to property transactions
summary:
Homebuyers using artificial intelligence to draft complaints and questions are creating additional work and delays in property transactions, according to conveyancing firm RG Law. The firm reports that clients are increasingly using AI to generate lengthy lists of questions without full understanding of their transaction's context.

title: Activist investor acquires 6% stake in Rightmove
summary:
US activist investment firm Sachem Head has acquired a 6% stake in Rightmove worth hundreds of millions of pounds, according to reports. The investment comes as the property portal's share price trades 39% below its 2025 peak following concerns about AI disruption.
